## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D Stardew farming by day, tower defense at night” game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using HTML, CSS, and Canvas JavaScript; farming and tower defense share a day/night cycle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented farming, crops, tools, turrets, enemies, waves, and UI in `game.js`.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript syntax, run the game, fix any issues, and capture/inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and resolve any syntax errors.
2. Start the game using the project’s supported runtime, exercise farming and night-defense gameplay, and inspect a recent small JPEG screenshot.
3. Briefly summarize assumptions and verification results when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page, UI, and Canvas element.
- `style.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic and rendering.

## Important Context
- An earlier version of `game.js` failed `node --check` with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'`; the file was then substantially rewritten, but syntax validation has not yet been rerun.
- Changes are uncommitted.
